name: io.github.sdvsignal/kit-one-tool-mcp
description: One-tool MCP server sample: described schema, unhappy paths handled, tests that need no API key.

environmentVariables.name: THING_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key for the service the tool calls. The sample returns a plain message instead of throwing when it is missing.

environmentVariables.name: THING_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the service the tool calls. Defaults to https://api.example.com in the sample.
